description: Image Description: The image features a bouquet of dried roses arranged in a translucent purple glass vase. The roses are in various stages of wilting, with their petals curled and browned, indicating they have been preserved or left to dry naturally. The color palette of the flowers ranges from muted pinks to deep browns and golden tones, creating a rustic and nostalgic aesthetic. The stems of the roses are tied together with a thin, dark string, which is visible through the clear glass of the vase.
